This root is found chiefly in frigid climates, especially in heaths, scrublands, and moors, and is best known in north-western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

To obtain its properties, it must be prepared as an infusion or decoction.

The root is burned, ground into powder, and mixed with boiling water. The preparation protects the eyes from glare for about nine hours. It is also known as Firegaze, Punasalvia, and Metsästäjän Ystävä.

Repeated use can lead to habituation.
